captionBasis: These two forms interleave their glyph runs, so text extracted from the content stream comes back scrambled ("Sheriff’s De partment", "The Defendan futrther shows"). A printed-caption check cannot be run on them, and a match loose enough to accept the scrambled text would pass on anything. Captions here are the AcroForm field names Colorado authored, which are meaningful and section-keyed, plus the printed section heading. The scrambled extraction at each widget's own coordinate is recorded beside it as evidence, for the reviewer who reads the paper.
